scenario_name: 1 omitted dimensions; intended use: Spring section (Sezione primavera)
initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer properties near public transport.

final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport. 'Prefer near' is a proximity expression, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface_area filter.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on property type 'Attività scolastiche', surface_area >= 180 sqm, mobility score >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Conditions are ordered strictest to softest. Results are sorted by distance from the coordinates. The 14-person capacity has no matching column in the allowlist, so it is not filtered.
